# Rally exclusive Oryx slot granted

Request c6863feb4355 is granted as generation1, lease f67ac234cf0e4c0cb583663ff73377cd. A fresh Oryx process/map inspection was empty immediately before grant. Central state is authoritative. Run your named sequential headless smoke and reversed-order full-race pairs with the preserved runtime/pins as already agreed; no parallel emulator instances, GUI, physical action or publication.

Assert-owner immediately before each launch and hold the lease until all your emulator/library processes stop. Preserve failures/retries as distinct evidence, take a fresh inspection and release explicitly after teardown, then mail results/release and notify Golem. The6–10minute estimate is planning only, not an automatic cancellation or expiry. Flexe is queued next; keep its processes and all unknown processes untouched.
